evidence:
Every plural/unchanged instance in the 3 gate, 38 functional and 6 polish criteria was enumerated (visual has none). SOUND over the whole collection: cw_block_indent_undo (both lines indented, third not; functional/judge.toml:74); cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic ('exactly once at each caret and nowhere else', :101); cw_multi_caret_delete (each of two carets, neighbours unchanged, :110); cw_same_line_carets (all three words, :119); cw_find_forward_backward_wrap (all three matches in order, near-match never visited, :137); cw_replace_current ('Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact', :146); cw_replace_all_atomic (all four, near-match unchanged, 'fewer or more than the four', :155); cw_replace_self_containing_text (exactly three, :164); cw_js/html_semantic_coloring (all five / four categories, declaration and call, :173, :182); cw_output_before_failure_kept (all three failure kinds, :245); cw_dynamic_code_refused (all five forms plus harmless control, :299); cw_save_reload_restart ('as one record', duplicated-or-missing, :308); cw_stale_save_refused (record AND history free of B's values, 'exactly one new revision', :317); cw_history_restore_retry (revisions one, two and three still listed, no fifth, :335); cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (title, filename, source, scroll, caret, undo; library change itself not punished, :353); cw_focus_returns_to_code (all five actions, polish/judge.toml:41); cw_undo_redo_availability (four points, :50); cw_narrow_width_usable (all five areas, :68); cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus (each offered control, :23).

DEFECT 1 (unchanged guard punishes a legitimate side effect of the same operation): functional/judge.toml:191 cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo says 'with the string and comment text preserved exactly ... Fails ... if the string or comment is altered', and :200 cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo says 'keeping the attribute value and comment exactly ... Fails ... if the attribute value or comment is altered'. functional/prompt.md:22 lets the judge 'choose the exact fixture text'. The brief (ui.md:15) only asks to 'preserve strings, comments and runtime meaning' and explicitly allows a standalone formatter. The golden formats with Prettier defaults (solution/app/src/custom-editor.js:82-86: tabWidth 2, semi true, no singleQuote), which rewrites a single-quoted JS string literal to double quotes and normalises a single-quoted HTML attribute to double quotes while leaving the contents intact. The guard does not say whether quote delimiters count as 'the string', so a normal formatter side effect can be read as 'altered'. The scripted golden run did not exercise this: its fixtures already use double quotes (qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/editor.cjs:279, :295 assert formatted.includes('"{;keep}"') and 'a > b'). No configured judge run exists, so this is NOT EXERCISED.

DEFECT 2 (overbroad unchanged guard): functional/judge.toml:290 cw_preview_isolation requires 'the app page, its title and its library entry must be unchanged afterwards'. The criterion's own steps legitimately change the app page (new source in the editor for each probe draft, console lines, status/reason text, the preview). The Fails clause is correctly scoped ('if the preview reads or changes anything of the playground page or its storage'), so the body sentence gives a second, stricter target.

DEFECT 3 (plural ask sampled by one member): behaviour.md:7 says 'Timers, intervals and Promise callbacks still pending from a stopped run must never change the preview or the console afterwards', and the same for a superseded run. functional/judge.toml:272 cw_stop_cancels_pending_work and :281 cw_newer_run_supersedes each use one timer only; no criterion uses an interval or a pending Promise callback after Stop or supersede. The scripted evidence likewise uses setTimeout only (runtime.cjs:66). This overlaps coverage row 26.

Minor, not blocking: ui.md:17 'a replacement' is graded with Replace all only (polish/judge.toml:41); 'main controls' in polish/judge.toml:32 is an undefined set.

The raw evidence is scripted golden behaviour only; it is not a configured judge run, Oracle, portal or model measurement, and it does not measure any of the three defects.
counterexample: Conforming app failed (Defect 1): the judge chooses a compact fixture with a single-quoted string such as let s='{;keep}' or an HTML attribute data-note='a > b'. The golden itself, and any submission using Prettier defaults as the brief permits, returns "{;keep}" / data-note="a > b". Runtime result is identical and the contents are intact, yet 'preserved exactly' / 'Fails if the string ... is altered' can be scored as a failure, losing weight 2.0 and 1.5. Conforming app failed (Defect 2): a literal reading of 'the app page ... must be unchanged' fails every app because the console and preview necessarily change during the probes. Broken app passing (Defect 3): an app that tracks and clears setTimeout handles on Stop but leaves setInterval callbacks and pending Promise chains running passes cw_stop_cancels_pending_work and cw_newer_run_supersedes while violating behaviour.md:7.
suggested_fix: 1) In both format criteria state the guard on contents: 'the characters inside the string and the comment (and inside the attribute value) must be unchanged; a change of quote style or of surrounding whitespace is not a failure'. 2) In cw_preview_isolation replace 'the app page, its title and its library entry must be unchanged' with 'the app page's title and the saved library entry must be unchanged; the editor, console, preview and status text changing through your own steps is expected'. 3) In cw_stop_cancels_pending_work make the stopped draft schedule a timeout, an interval and a delayed Promise callback, each writing its own marker, and require that none of the three appears; confirm the golden with a scripted run before freezing.
